title: Italian Sausage Pasta
steps:
Boil the pasta.
Cut the broccoli,
chop the garlic

Brown sausage to
160°F. Add garlic
+ broccoli, 5 min

Toss in the pasta,
top with mozzarella
+ a squeeze of lemon
vo: One skillet, one pot, dinner in thirty minutes.
Tonight: Italian sausage pasta with broccoli.
You need Italian sausage, pasta, two heads of broccoli, garlic, mozzarella and a lemon.
Boil the pasta, and while it cooks, cut the broccoli and chop the garlic.
Brown the sausage until it hits one sixty inside, then add the garlic and broccoli for five minutes.
Toss in the pasta, top with mozzarella, and squeeze lemon over everything.
